images.alt: A red R1R1 flower and a white R2R2 flower at the top are joined by a cross sign. Arrows from both lead to a pink R1R2 flower below. The diagram abbreviates reproduction between the parent and offspring levels.

The standard three-allele ABO model produces four possible offspring genotypes in this cross. Each letter marks one phenotype to infer from its genotype.

The cross IAIA × IBi appears above a square. IA is repeated in both top columns. The left rows are IB and i. The upper cells are both IAIB and the lower cells both IAi. Repeated IA columns represent one distinct egg allele type.
